title: Map furniture and map colour — Image Wiki

rules.rule: Use a sequential colour scheme for ordered data where lightness climbs steadily with value to avoid inventing perceptual boundaries.
rules.evidence: The same argument condemns the rainbow twice over: it invents boundaries, and it collapses in greyscale, because its lightness goes up and down.

rules.rule: Ensure labels drop by rank as screen space shrinks at zoomed-out scales to prevent collisions between nearby features.
rules.evidence: A label must not collide at any zoom, and the zoom is continuous, so the renderer drops labels by rank as space runs out.

rules.rule: Verify a map's colour scheme remains legible when converted to greyscale or viewed at half size on small devices.
rules.evidence: Check it in grey, at the smallest size, and on the smallest device you support.
